events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Viktor Arvidsson scored twice, Joonas Korpisalo made 36 saves and the Boston Bruins beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-2 on Thursday night in the first game for both teams after the three-week break for the Olympics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Viktor Arvidsson scores twice in the Bruins' 4-2 win over the Blue Jackets

events.name: New York Islanders at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Jean-Gabriel Pageau scored 3:14 into overtime, rookie Matthew Schaefer had two goals in a 55-second span in the second period and the New York Islanders rallied to beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pageau's OT winner caps Islanders' rally past Canadiens 4-3 and Schaefer sets another rookie mark

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Dylan Larkin scored in his second goal of game at 1:50 of overtime, John Gibson made 26 saves and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Ottawa Senators 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Larkin scores his 2nd goal of game in OT to lift Red Wings past Senators, 2-1

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Olympic silver medalist Brad Marchand scored twice, Evan Rodrigues got the first short-handed goal of his career and added an assist, and the Florida Panthers resumed their playoff push with a 5-1 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchand scores 2 as the Panthers reignite their playoff push vs. Maple Leafs with 5-1 win

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Connor Clifton and Egor Chinakhov scored 50 seconds apart in the third period and the Pittsburgh Penguins surged past Jack Hughes and the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Late goals by Clifton and Chinakhov push the Penguins past Jack Hughes and the Devils 4-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Sebastian Aho banged in a power-play goal through traffic midway through the third period to help the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aho's power-play goal helps Hurricanes beat Lightning 5-4 in meeting of Eastern Conference's best

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Matvei Michkov scored his second goal of the game 2:10 into overtime and Samuel Ersson made 23 saves as the Philadelphia Flyers rallied to beat the New York Rangers 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matvei Michkov scores in overtime to give the Flyers a 3-2 win over the Rangers

events.name: Seattle Kraken at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Dylan Holloway had a hat trick and added an assist in his return from a sprained ankle, Joel Hofer made 23 saves and the St. Louis Blues came off the Olympic break to beat the Seattle Kraken 5-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Holloway has hat trick in injury return to lead Blues past Kraken, 5-1

headlines.description: — Ryan O'Reilly scored with 3:16 remaining and the Nashville Predators scored three times in the third period in a 4-2 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday night in the teams’ first game following the Olympic break.
headlines.shortLinkText: O'Reilly scores late and Predators use 3 goals in the 3rd period to beat the Blackhawks 4-2

headlines.description: — U.S. Olympian Matt Boldy had two goals and two assists, Filip Gustavsson stopped 44 shots and the Minnesota Wild beat the Colorado Avalanche 5-2 on Thursday night for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: U.S. Olympian Matt Boldy has 2 goals and 2 assists in Wild's 5-2 win over Avs

events.name: Calgary Flames at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Nazem Kadri scored two goals and the Calgary Flames beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Thursday night in the first game back from the Olympic break for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nazem Kadri scores 2 goals to lead the Flames to a 4-1 win over the Sharks

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid secured his ninth 100-point season with a goal and an assist, Leon Draisaitl had a goal and three assists, and the Edmonton Oilers snapped their four-game skid with an 8-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid, Leon Draisaitl lead Oilers' 8-1 rout of struggling Kings
